title: Wheat leaf high-molecular weight (HMW) DNA extraction
author: Maximillian RW Jones

steps.title: Prepare Buffers
steps.instruction: Prepare the necessary buffers for the extraction process.

substeps.instruction: Prepare 10x HB buffer.
Prepare 1xHB/β-ME by adding 640 µL β-mercaptoethanol to 160 mL of 1xHBS in a fume hood and mixing well.

steps.title: Collect and Prepare Leaf Tissue
steps.instruction: Collect high-quality wheat leaf tissue while maintaining sterility and avoiding damage.

substeps.instruction: Sanitize scissors, tools, and gloved hands with 70% ethanol.
Collect 2-5 g of leaf blade tissue (avoiding sheath, diseased, bleached, or senescing sections) into a 50 mL Falcon tube using forceps to avoid bruising.
Re-sanitize tools and hands between samples.
If extracting immediately, bury the Falcon tube up to the cap in ice; otherwise, snap freeze in liquid nitrogen and store at -70 to -80 °C.

steps.title: Set Up Fume Hood and Equipment
steps.instruction: Organize the workspace and equipment on ice before beginning the crude nuclei extraction.

substeps.instruction: Prepare the fume hood with: Blender (~1 L volume, preferably glass-walled), tissue samples on ice, 1xHB on ice (100 mL/sample), H+20 buffer on ice (5 mL/sample), β-mercaptoethanol (400 µL/sample), 250 mL conical centrifuge bombs on ice (e.g., Corning CLS430776; do not use flat-bottomed bottles), Mira/cheese-cloth filtration sandwiches, large plastic funnel, 100 mL graduated cylinder, glass rod, scissors, timer, 70% ethanol, blue roll, and a 1 L waste beaker.
Set up the centrifuge with the correct rotor and swing bucket attachments and cool to 4 °C.
Place 5 mL of H+20 buffer into a 250 mL centrifuge bottle per sample, label, and place on ice.

steps.title: Homogenize Tissue
steps.instruction: Blend the leaf tissue with buffer to create a suspension.

substeps.instruction: Measure 100 mL of 1xHB/β-ME into the blender (increase to 150 mL if using more than 5 g of tissue).
Cut plant tissue into small pieces directly into the blender.
Blend on a low setting until tissue is incorporated into suspension, then blend on high for one minute.

steps.title: Filter Crude Nuclei
steps.instruction: Filter the homogenized sample to isolate nuclei.

substeps.instruction: Place a large plastic funnel into a 250 mL centrifuge bomb on ice.
Insert the Mira/cheese-cloth sandwich and push down with a glass rod or gloved finger.
Filter the ground sample through the filtration sandwich into the centrifuge bomb.
While filtering, rinse the blender and lid under a fast-flowing tap.
Squeeze remaining liquid from the cloth into a waste beaker and discard the cloth in a chemical waste bin.
Rinse the funnel and gloved hands; wipe scissor blades with 70% ethanol.
Cap the centrifuge bomb, shake gently, and place back on ice.

steps.title: Initial Nuclei Pelleting
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the filtered samples to pellet the nuclei.

substeps.instruction: Spin samples for 20 minutes at 1500 x g at 4 °C (use H2O-filled balance bombs or iced 1xHB/β-ME to balance).
Repeat for all samples.
Incubate samples on ice for at least 10 minutes.

steps.title: Wash and Purify Nuclei
steps.instruction: Perform a series of washes to clean the nuclei pellet.

substeps.instruction: Carefully pour off the supernatant into the waste bucket and invert the bottle onto stacked paper towels to remove excess liquid.
Add 1 mL of ice-cold 1xHB/β-ME to each centrifuge bottle.
Resuspend the pellet using a clean paint brush (soaked in 1xHB) and mix with a P1000 pipette using a cut-tip until homogeneous.
Transfer the sample to a 50 mL pre-labelled Oakridge tube.
Bring the volume to approximately 15 mL using ice-cold 1xHB/β-ME.
Spin for 10 min at 1100 x g at 4 °C.
Repeat the decanting, resuspension, and spinning process twice more until the supernatant is transparent.

steps.title: Final Nuclei Resuspension
steps.instruction: Resuspend the purified nuclei for downstream processing.

substeps.instruction: Decant the supernatant and add 1 mL of ice-cold 1xHB to the pellet per gram of tissue processed (e.g., 3 mL for 3 g tissue).
Resuspend the pellet using a fresh paint brush pre-soaked in ice-cold 1xHB and mix with a P1000 pipette using a cut-tip until homogeneous.

steps.title: Aliquot and Final Spin
steps.instruction: Transfer the nuclei suspension to microcentrifuge tubes and pellet.

substeps.instruction: Transfer each mL of the nuclei suspension into a fresh 2 mL Protein LoBind microcentrifuge tube (1 g tissue per tube).
Spin the 2 mL tubes for 5 min at 7,000 x g at room temperature.

steps.title: Storage or Downstream Processing
steps.instruction: Either proceed immediately to HMW DNA extraction or store the pellets.

substeps.instruction: To store, snap freeze the nuclei pellets in liquid nitrogen and store at -70 to -80 °C (tested viable up to 1 week).
For HMW DNA extraction, follow the PacBio Nanobind® plant nuclei kit and protocol, substituting 1.5 mL tubes with 2 mL Protein LoBind tubes to prevent disks from becoming lodged.
